verdict.rationale: Klaviyo exposes a full REST API secured by API keys/OAuth, with maintained SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and a sandbox test account for safely automating campaign creation, imports, etc. — enough to script/automate outside the UI, but there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, CLI tool, or headless-runner guidance in the evidence. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD integration docs, official CLI, and any explicit statement about running headlessly in automated pipelines.
